schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMSBY

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National mission for comprehensive financial inclusion ensuring universal access to banking facilities with at least one basic banking account for every unbanked household.
schemes.benefit: Zero balance savings account with no minimum balance penalty, free RuPay debit card with inbuilt ₹2,00,000 accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar card (or any Officially Valid Document: Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN card, NREGA Job Card), passport photograph.
schemes.application_process: Open a basic savings bank deposit account (BSBDA) at any bank branch or Bank Mitra / Business Correspondent outlet with valid KYC.
schemes.source_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana National Portal

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme comprising five sub-schemes that provides social security pensions and financial assistance to destitute senior citizens, widows, disabled persons, and bereaved BPL families.
schemes.benefit: Regular monthly direct benefit transfer pension and one-time family bereavement support administered in partnership with State Governments.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar card, BPL ration card / SECC enumeration proof, age proof, bank passbook, death/disability certificate where applicable.
schemes.application_process: Apply online via nsap.nic.in, Umang mobile app, or submit physical application to the Block Development Officer (BDO) or Municipal Ward Officer.
schemes.source_name: National Social Assistance Programme Portal

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly non-contributory old age pension to persons aged 60 years or above living below the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of ₹200 (for age 60–79 years) and ₹500 (for age 80 years and above) provided by Central Government, with additional state contributions varying from ₹500 to ₹2,500/month.
schemes.required_documents: Age proof (voter ID / Aadhaar / birth certificate), BPL ration card / BPL certificate, bank account passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / BDO office in rural areas or Municipal Municipality office in urban areas, or online via NSAP portal.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNOAPS

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly financial assistance and dignity to destitute widows aged 40–59 years living below the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Monthly central pension of ₹300 per month (supplemented with additional state top-up allowances ranging from ₹700 to ₹2,200/month) directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.required_documents: Death certificate of husband, age proof (40–59 years), BPL certificate / Ration card, Aadhaar card, bank account passbook.
schemes.application_process: Submit application at the Block Development Office or Municipal office with death certificate of the spouse and BPL proof.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNWPS

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly pension to persons aged 18–79 years with severe or multiple disabilities living below the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Monthly central pension of ₹300 per month (increased to ₹500/month at age 80+) with supplementary state top-ups ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.
beneficiary_groups: persons with severe or multiple disabilities
schemes.required_documents: Medical certificate showing 80% or more disability or multiple disabilities (or UDID card), age proof (18+), BPL card, Aadhaar, bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at nsap.nic.in or at the District Social Welfare Office / BDO office.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNDPS

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
schemes.description: NSAP component providing immediate lump sum financial relief to a below-poverty-line household upon the death of the primary breadwinner.
schemes.benefit: One-time lump sum grant of ₹20,000 transferred to the surviving head of the household upon the death of the primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 years.
schemes.required_documents: Death certificate of the breadwinner, age proof showing breadwinner was 18–59 years at death, BPL verification, Aadhaar, bank passbook of surviving head.
schemes.application_process: Submit application within six months of the breadwinner's death to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / BDO / Municipal office.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — NFBS

schemes.name: Annapurna Scheme (Food Security for Indigent Senior Citizens)
schemes.description: Component under NSAP providing 10 kg of food grains per month free of cost to indigent senior citizens who, though eligible, remain uncovered under IGNOAPS.
schemes.benefit: 10 kilograms of food grains (rice/wheat) per month completely free through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) fair price shops.
schemes.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution / NSAP
beneficiary_groups: indigent senior citizens aged 65 and above without pension
schemes.required_documents: Age proof (65 years and above), declaration of receiving no regular pension, residence proof, Aadhaar card.
schemes.application_process: Identified by District Administration / Food and Civil Supplies Department; special Annapurna ration cards are issued.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — Annapurna

schemes.name: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)
schemes.description: Umbrella scheme supporting quality of life, care, shelter, health and active ageing of senior citizens through components and implementing agencies. Archived component.
schemes.benefit: Services and support varied by component and implementing agency under legacy guidelines; earlier components have been restructured into dedicated national initiatives.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.required_documents: Legacy component documentation.
schemes.application_process: Archived scheme component; check current restructured social justice schemes.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — AVYAY Archive

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
schemes.description: Government pension programme for senior citizens aged 60 years and above managed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). Officially closed for new subscription on 31 March 2023.
schemes.benefit: Assured pension payout of 7.4% per annum for 10 years on purchase price up to ₹15 lakh; ongoing payouts continue for existing subscribers until tenure completion.
schemes.required_documents: Official gazette notification confirming sunset date of 31 March 2023.
schemes.application_process: Scheme closed for fresh enrollment on 31st March 2023. Existing policyholders service accounts through LIC branches.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMVVY

schemes.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
schemes.description: Pioneering rights-based social assistance scheme of the Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly financial grant to eligible women heads of households.
schemes.benefit: Monthly cash support of ₹1,000 transferred directly through DBT into the bank accounts of eligible women family heads.
schemes.department: Special Programme Implementation Department / Revenue Department
schemes.required_documents: Smart Family Card (Ration Card), Aadhaar card, electricity bill, bank account passbook linked with Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply during special camp drives at neighborhood ration fair price shops or submit application at e-Sevai centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — KMUT Portal

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu flagship scheme providing monthly financial assistance to girl students who studied Classes VI to XII in government schools to pursue higher education.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 directly transferred to the girl student's bank account until successful completion of undergraduate degree/diploma/ITI.
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
schemes.required_documents: School study certificate proving government school study from Class VI to XII (EMIS number), college admission receipt, Aadhaar card, bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pudhumaimaipen.tn.gov.in through the principal/nodal officer of the admitting college or institution.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Pudhumai Penn Portal

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Flagship healthcare assurance scheme of Government of Tamil Nadu providing cashless hospital treatment through public and private empaneled hospitals.
schemes.benefit: Cashless hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,090 surgical and medical procedures including specialized surgeries and organ transplants.
schemes.required_documents: Smart Family Ration Card, Aadhaar cards of family members, income certificate (family income below ₹1,20,000/year).
schemes.application_process: Enroll at the District Collectorate CMCHIS kiosk with Smart Ration Card and Income Certificate to obtain CMCHIS biometric smart card.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Health & Family Welfare

schemes.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu state maternal health scheme providing financial assistance and nutritional kits to poor pregnant women before and after institutional delivery.
schemes.benefit: Total assistance of ₹18,000 per beneficiary: cash assistance of ₹14,000 in five instalments via DBT and two Amma Maternity Nutrition Kits valued at ₹4,000.
schemes.department: Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department
schemes.required_documents: RCH ID from PICME portal, Aadhaar card, bank passbook, MCP card, delivery discharge summary from government institution.
schemes.application_process: Pre-register pregnancy on PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation) portal via Village Health Nurse (VHN) before 12 weeks.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — PICME Portal

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: First-of-its-kind state initiative providing hot cooked wholesome breakfast to primary school children (Classes I to V) in all government schools.
schemes.benefit: Hot freshly prepared nutritious breakfast (such as upma, pongal, kichadi with vegetable sambar) on all school working days before classes begin.
schemes.department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
schemes.required_documents: School admission register enrollment.
schemes.application_process: Universal coverage for all enrolled students in government primary schools across Tamil Nadu; no application needed.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu Official Portal

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
schemes.description: State welfare scheme providing monthly maintenance allowance to persons with severe disabilities and mental retardation who cannot engage in gainful employment.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 (enhanced up to ₹2,000 for severely bedridden beneficiaries) disbursed directly through bank accounts.
schemes.department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
beneficiary_groups: persons with severe disabilities (75% and above)
schemes.required_documents: National Disability Identity Card / UDID card (75% or above disability), medical board certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account passbook, family ration card.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer (DDAWO) located at the District Collectorate.
schemes.source_name: Tamil Nadu Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: State financial assistance scheme to help poor parents educate their daughters up to marriageable age and provide marriage grants with 8 grams of gold coin.
schemes.benefit: Financial grant of ₹25,000 (for Class X passed) or ₹50,000 (for degree/diploma holders) plus a sovereign (8 grams) 22-carat gold coin (Thirumangalyam) for marriage.
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
schemes.required_documents: Educational certificates (Class 10 mark sheet or Degree diploma), wedding invitation card, family income certificate (below ₹72,000/year), age proof (bride min 18 years, groom min 21 years), Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply online through e-Sevai centres or at the Block Development Office at least 40 days prior to the wedding date.
schemes.source_name: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare — Marriage Assistance

schemes.name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Social security scheme of Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly pension and free clothing to destitute widows with no adult earning children.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,000 plus free supply of two sarees per year (on Pongal and Deepavali festivals) and free bus travel passes.
schemes.required_documents: Death certificate of husband, Destitute Widow Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Revenue Divisional Officer, family income certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the nearest e-Sevai Centre or submit application to the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme).
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Social Security Pensions

schemes.name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Flagship scheme of Tamil Nadu MSME Department to assist educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs in manufacturing or service sectors.
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy of 25% of the project cost (up to ₹75 lakh) and 3% interest subvention during the entire tenure of the bank loan.
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.required_documents: Degree/Diploma certificate, project profile/DPR, nativity certificate, Aadhaar card, bank loan consent letter, EDI training completion proof.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at msmeonline.tn.gov.in/needs, followed by interview and selection by the District Task Force Committee headed by District Collector.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Online Portal

schemes.name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: State credit-linked subsidy scheme to mitigate unemployment by establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing, services, and business trades.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of 25% of project cost (up to ₹2.5 lakh for manufacturing, ₹1.25 lakh for services, and ₹75,000 for business) with 7-day EDP training.
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.required_documents: Class 8 passing certificate or higher, family income certificate (up to ₹5,00,000/year), project quotation, Aadhaar card.
schemes.application_process: Apply online via msmeonline.tn.gov.in/uyegp; shortlisted candidates are interviewed by District Task Force Committee.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — UYEGP Portal

schemes.name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu initiative providing comprehensive financial assistance to aspiring Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs for starting manufacturing, service, or trading enterprises.
schemes.benefit: 35% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹35 lakh, and 6% interest subvention for the entire loan repayment period.
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.required_documents: Community certificate (SC/ST), project proposal, plant and machinery quotation, Aadhaar, PAN, educational proof.
schemes.application_process: Submit online application at msmeonline.tn.gov.in; sponsored to commercial banks or TIIC for project loan sanction.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Portal

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.description: One of the five flagship guarantees of the Government of Karnataka, providing direct financial assistance to female heads of families.
schemes.benefit: Monthly direct cash benefit of ₹2,000 transferred via DBT to the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of eligible women heads of households.
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_groups: Antyodaya, BPL and APL ration card holders
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar card of woman head and husband, Ration Card (APL/BPL/AAY card showing applicant as head), bank passbook seeded with Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at Seva Sindhu portal or through Karnataka One, Grama One, and Bangalore One citizen centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka — Seva Sindhu Portal

schemes.name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.description: State guarantee scheme providing monthly unemployment allowance to educated youth who remain unemployed 180 days after graduation.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years or until gainful employment is found.
schemes.department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
schemes.required_documents: Degree/Diploma marks card, Karnataka domicile certificate (studied in Karnataka for min 6 years), Aadhaar card, self-declaration of unemployment.
schemes.application_process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu portal after completing the mandatory 180-day post-graduation waiting period without employment.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka — Seva Sindhu

schemes.name: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana (Karnataka)
schemes.description: Social security pension scheme of the Government of Karnataka providing financial security and dignity to elderly citizens from weaker sections.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,200 transferred directly through DBT to the elderly beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.department: Revenue Department / Directorate of Social Security and Pensions
beneficiary_groups: elderly persons in low income households
schemes.required_documents: Age certificate showing 65 years and above, income certificate (combined income of husband and wife below ₹20,000/year), domicile proof, Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply at Nadakacheri (Atalji Janasnehi Kendra) or through Seva Sindhu centres in Karnataka.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka Official Portal

schemes.name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP, Kerala)
schemes.description: Comprehensive health insurance scheme implemented by Government of Kerala in convergence with AB-PMJAY to provide free tertiary and secondary care.
schemes.benefit: Hospitalization insurance cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private healthcare facilities in Kerala.
schemes.required_documents: Ration card, Aadhaar cards of family members, existing health scheme card (if any).
schemes.application_process: Check family entitlement on the SHA Kerala portal with Ration Card number; collect KASP card from Akshaya centres.
schemes.source_name: State Health Agency Kerala — KASP

schemes.name: Kerala Agricultural Workers Pension Scheme
schemes.description: Statutory social security pension scheme providing monthly pension to elderly agricultural labourers who have worked in Kerala agricultural lands.
schemes.benefit: Monthly direct pension of ₹1,600 transferred directly into the bank accounts of registered agricultural workers.
schemes.required_documents: Age proof (60+ years), certificate of 10 years agricultural labour in Kerala, annual income certificate (below ₹1,00,000), Aadhaar, bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the local Grama Panchayat / Municipality office with certification of agricultural labour from the Agricultural Officer.
schemes.source_name: Government of Kerala Official Portal

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.description: Direct benefit transfer scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing economic empowerment and self-reliance to women aged 21–65 years.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of eligible women.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar card, domicile certificate / birth certificate of Maharashtra, family income certificate (annual income below ₹2.5 lakh), bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in, via Nari Shakti Doot mobile app, or at Setu Suvidha / Anganwadi centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Maharashtra — Ladki Bahin Portal

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY, Maharashtra)
schemes.description: Flagship health insurance scheme of Government of Maharashtra providing cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatment through empaneled hospitals.
schemes.benefit: Cashless medical and surgical cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,356 identified surgical and medical therapies.
schemes.department: Public Health Department / State Health Assurance Society
beneficiary_groups: citizens of Maharashtra holding valid ration cards
schemes.required_documents: Valid Ration Card (Yellow, Orange, or White), photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID), hospital referral slip.
schemes.application_process: Visit the Aarogyamitra kiosk at any network hospital with valid Ration Card and photo identity proof for pre-authorization.
schemes.source_name: State Health Assurance Society — MJPJAY

schemes.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.description: Social assistance scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing monthly financial assistance to destitute persons, widows, and severely disabled persons.
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 per month (₹1,500 for single beneficiary; ₹2,500 for family with multiple eligible dependents).
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
schemes.required_documents: Domicile certificate of Maharashtra (15 years residence), income certificate (family income below ₹21,000/year), disability certificate or death certificate of husband, Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply at the Taluk Tahsildar office or online via Aaple Sarkar portal in Maharashtra.
schemes.source_name: Social Justice Department Maharashtra — Sanjay Gandhi Scheme

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Sikkim)
schemes.description: Sikkim state pension scheme for older residents delivering social security to senior citizens living below poverty line in Sikkim.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (Central + Sikkim state share) directly credited to elderly residents' bank accounts.
schemes.required_documents: Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification, age proof (60+ years), BPL verification, Aadhaar, bank passbook.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the Gram Vikas Adhikari / Block Administrative Centre or online via the Sikkim Pension portal.
schemes.source_name: Government of Sikkim — Pension Scheme

schemes.name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA, Odisha)
schemes.description: Comprehensive welfare scheme launched by Government of Odisha to support small and marginal farmers and landless agricultural households.
schemes.benefit: Direct financial assistance of ₹4,000 per year for small and marginal farmers, and ₹12,500 one-time livelihood assistance for landless agricultural households.
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar card, land records (for cultivators) or MGNREGA job card (for landless workers), bank passbook seeded with Aadhaar.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at kalia.odisha.gov.in or submit green application forms at Gram Panchayat nodal offices.
schemes.source_name: Government of Odisha — KALIA Portal

schemes.name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY, Odisha)
schemes.description: Universal health assurance scheme of Government of Odisha providing cashless healthcare treatment in empaneled government and private hospitals.
schemes.benefit: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, and up to ₹10 lakh per year for female members of the family.
beneficiary_groups: BPL and National/State Food Security Card holders
schemes.required_documents: BSKY Smart Health Card or National Food Security Card (NFSA/SFSA), Aadhaar card.
schemes.application_process: Card issued to all NFSA and SFSA cardholders; swipe BSKY smart card at any empaneled hospital helpdesk.
schemes.source_name: Government of Odisha — Health & Family Welfare
